content: Do not use any tools. Write exactly three sentences explaining why the ocean appears blue.

The ocean appears blue because water absorbs more of the longer red, orange, and yellow wavelengths of sunlight. Blue wavelengths are scattered and reflected more effectively, making them more visible to our eyes. The sky’s blue reflection can contribute, but the water’s selective absorption and scattering are the main reasons.
Do not use any tools. Write exactly three sentences explaining why sunsets appear red.

Sunsets appear red because sunlight travels through a greater thickness of atmosphere when the Sun is near the horizon. Air molecules scatter shorter blue and violet wavelengths away from the direct beam more strongly than longer red and orange wavelengths. The remaining light reaching our eyes is therefore dominated by warm red, orange, and pink colors.
